question1.taxonomyNote: 转写 includes prose/rounding and retrieval-absence assertion; 缩放 is an actual number conversion error; 标签错位 includes year/metric/unit/attachment mapping and omission; 方向语义 is sign/direction wording; 版式 is layout/formatting. Mixed review items carry more than one category. Not every defect fits a copied-tool-number premise.

method.countingUnit: One actual run_analysis invocation or run_financial_model call, not occurrences in system prompts. Python helper usage is parsed from the submitted/effective analysis.py AST with imported aliases resolved.
method.attempts: Feature is present in actual arguments/effective submitted code. Same-task patch reruns count as new attempts.
method.failedAttempts: Containing tool call errored or analysis terminal status failed; not necessarily the feature caused failure. Full original messages/stderr retained in toolSequence and abandonmentEpisodes.
method.successfulAttempts: Containing analysis succeeded; quality defects can remain.
method.finallyAdopted: 0/1 per task: feature present in the last successful analysis that attached outputs. report-only/copy reruns and old attachments documented separately.
method.everDeliveredSuccessfully: 0/1 per task: feature used in any succeeded attached version, including an earlier retained version.
method.abandonedAfterErrorToCustomCode: A failed feature attempt followed by a successful switch: report paths -> custom exports without either report route; placeholders -> manually written body even if tables still use report; source_run_id+edits -> new full code without source_run_id. This is observed sequence, not proof of motive.
method.placeholderPattern: Only actual {{table.numericRow.column}} references count. Previous-study E2 has a homemade {{eps}}/replace template and is separately excluded from this API funnel.
method.report_file_protocol: Additional necessary route: actual Python writes analysis_report.json. Omitted report parameter does not mean unified rendering was bypassed.
method.availability: finance_charts/model_refs/run_financial_model available in financial profile, not the prepared/generic baselines. Zero adoption is reported with available-task denominator.
method.sourceReuseScope: All observed source_run_id+edits patch scripts within the current task; none patch a preceding-task calculator.
method.preExecutionEditErrors: A source_run_id+edits request rejected before a new effective script exists is counted for the edit interface; other script-only features are not inferred from an unexecuted hypothetical patched script. These errors are also preserved in abandonment chains.

method.targetDocuments: Every final answer plus every attached Markdown report, including older attached versions and E3 局部更新报告.md. Latest-report aggregate counts one report per completed task; all versions remain in documents.
method.countingUnit: Occurrence, not unique value. Financial amounts/per-share values, share counts, percentage/percentage-point values, multiples and FX with explicit token, row/column header or local declared units. Exclude years, dates, page/cell/figure IDs, pure formula constants and unlabelled multipliers.
method.toolCorpus: Actual native toolResult text blocks corresponding to eligible audit calls, from this persistent conversation through this task inclusive; includes previous question of same chat, excludes future turns, schemas, skills/examples, arbitrary artifact disk contents and other conversations. get_artifact metadata is not a report read.
method.same_unit_exact: Decimal value and canonical dimension/currency/scale identical to a model-visible tool-output quantity. Common spellings normalized.
method.unit_conversion_exact: Same dimension and currency with an exact decimal scale conversion; no approximate match or FX conversion assumed.
method.not_found_exact: No exact match under those units. Separately expose matches that become equal only after displayed rounding. Unknown unit candidates are retained outside the denominator.
method.rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP to the target displayed decimal places; supplementary diagnostic only, not moved into exact classes.
importantLimits: This is value/unit coverage, not semantic lineage or accuracy: F2 wrong-year EPS0.83 still numerically matches the correct2025 EPS0.83.
Some missing values are correct computations never returned in stdout; some are rounding or ambiguous units, not hallucinations.
Generated report tables returned by the tool can echo participant-supplied numbers. A match does not establish independent correctness.

Unit parsing is deterministic with explicit local human unit adjudications (unitAdjudication); remaining ambiguous candidates are visible. No blanket claim of human-verified completeness or numerical correctness is made from the aggregate.
Paths and line numbers identify original evidence; normalizedColumn is after Markdown/reference cleanup, not an original-file byte offset.
method.unitAdjudications: Finite local readings are explicit in each affected quantity.unitAdjudication; they assign units only, never alter a reported value to match a reference.

correctionsToInitialHypothesis: Not all errors are copying a correct tool-returned value: main C1 margins and E2 sensitivity were computed correctly in files but not returned as values to the model.
Cash-interest sign errors also occurred in prepared baselines, including an earlier final report.
Unified reports were used through analysis_report.json more often than counting report arguments alone suggests; unsuccessful/schema-friction and partial adoption remain real.
Financial chart themes did run automatically; specialist plotting helpers did not.
All9 updates rewrote calculators with retained prior code/run IDs, so compaction loss is not supported.
